# Transient

Transient gives Obsidian a translucent look by blending glass-like surfaces with soft, modern accents. The recorded description presents it as a minimalist, immersive workspace meant to keep the interface out of the way of the notes, and records nothing about supported modes, settings or plugins.

![Transient screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeazma/Transient/HEAD/theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Transient"
    author: "georgeazma"
    repo:   "georgeazma/Transient"
    slug:   "transient"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/transient"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/georgeazma/Transient"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeazma/Transient/HEAD/theme.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a translucent, futuristic, and cozy look to Obsidian by blending glass-like surfaces with soft, modern accents. Create a minimalist, immersive workspace that keeps the interface sleek and focuses attention on your notes."
}
```
